summary: Build Blueprints 37-41 wiring verified end-to-end. Backend: 33/33 pytest cases pass covering B40 design (public tokens/foundation + admin overview/registry/components incl. approve-before-a11y=passed rejection AND safety_card born-approved rejection), B39 platform (domains, api-standards, events list, invalid event_type => 400, valid project.started event recorded), B37 release (dashboard, releases/incidents/flags lists, release create + status transition to deployed), B38 invintel dashboard + 7 list endpoints, B41 user search (kitchen/electrical/shelf/warranty/light fixture, projects rank above guides for 'electrical', nonsense query => result_count 0, POST /select ok, context_type=room scoping strips global guides/templates/community, cross-user isolation verified: demo user owner-scoped ids disjoint from admin owner-scoped ids), B41 admin search (health, reindex, config GET/PUT, synonyms CRUD, logs). Frontend: /design-system renders buttons, safety cards, AI response card, states, tokens (all testIDs present). Demo login → home tab shows home-search magnify icon which opens /find; typing 'kitchen' returns grouped results, 'zzz_nomatch_iter77' shows EmptyState + 5 no-result action chips. Admin sidebar exposes 5 new keys design/searchops/release/invintel/platform, each renders without crashing, and existing modules (overview, homiehq, communityhub, voice) still work — no admin menu key collisions.

ui_bugs.issue: MaterialCommunityIcons emits console warning "fridge-plus-outline" is not a valid icon name for family 'material-community' (used in noResultActions 'Add Asset' chip).

action_items: Optional cosmetic: change 'fridge-plus-outline' to a valid MaterialCommunityIcons name (e.g. 'fridge-outline' or 'plus-box-outline') in /app/frontend/app/find.tsx noResultActions to silence the icon-name warning.
critical_code_review_comments: search_engine.py: authorization is enforced BEFORE ranking — private records are resolved strictly from the caller's own hi_properties (pid) and user_id (uid); cross-user isolation confirmed via test (admin vs demo 'kitchen' — owner-scoped id sets are disjoint).
search_engine.py _sanitize() correctly redacts token-like strings from logs and truncates to 200 chars, preventing sensitive info in search_query_logs.

design_engine.py enforces two independent guardrails: (a) safety_card cannot be created with status=approved (product+content ownership) and (b) any component transitioning to 'approved' requires accessibility_review_status=passed — both verified.

release_engine.py update_release blocks completion unless rollback_plan exists AND all CRITICAL_JOURNEYS pass AND no failing AI eval cases — good gating. (Not exercised end-to-end in tests, but logic reviewed.)
platform_engine.emit_event is a clean reusable helper other engines can call, and event_type is validated against DOMAIN_EVENTS on the admin POST path.

investor_intel_engine.py namespace is /api/hi/admin/invintel/* (NOT /investor_intel as written in the review request). The engine and mount in server.py are consistent; only the review request text has a stale name — no code fix needed.
All 5 new engines exclude MongoDB _id via projections (or .pop('_id', None) after insert) — no ObjectId serialization risk observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (design-system + home-search + /find + all 5 new admin modules + regression on existing admin keys)
